const CATS = {
  all:       "All",
  leadership:"Leadership",
  pc:        "PC & Review",
  org:       "Organisation & Workshops",
  exam:      "Examination",
  editorial: "Editorial",
  devel:     "Professional Development"
};

const CBADGE = {
  leadership:"background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489",
  pc:        "background:#e8f1fb;color:#0c447c",
  org:       "background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041",
  exam:      "background:#f1efe8;color:#444441",
  editorial: "background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806",
  devel:     "background:#fbeaf0;color:#72243e"
};

let activeCat = "all";

function render() {
  const filtered = SERVICE.filter(i => activeCat === "all" || i.cat === activeCat);

  const filters = Object.entries(CATS).map(([k,v]) => {
    const on = activeCat === k;
    const style = on
      ? "background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;"
      : "background:white;color:#6c757d;border-color:#dde4ed;";
    const count = k === "all" ? SERVICE.length : SERVICE.filter(i=>i.cat===k).length;
    return `<span onclick="setCat('${k}')" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;${style}">${v} <span style="opacity:0.7">(${count})</span></span>`;
  }).join("");

  const items = filtered.map(i => {
    const badge = `<span style="font-size:9px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;margin-right:6px;${CBADGE[i.cat]}">${CATS[i.cat]}</span>`;
    const link = i.url ? `<a href="${i.url}" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#2d7dd2;">More info →</a>` : "";
    return `<div style="padding:0.85rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4;">
      <div style="font-size:0.93rem;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:3px;">${badge}${i.title}</div>
      ${i.detail ? `<div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#6c757d;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:3px;">${i.detail}</div>` : ""}
      ${link}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");

  document.getElementById("service-app").innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px;">${filters}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:12px;">Showing <strong>${filtered.length}</strong> of <strong>${SERVICE.length}</strong> items</div>
    ${items}
  `;
}

function setCat(cat) { activeCat = cat; render(); }
render();
</script>
